root_cause: Daily rci-* calendar rows in social_experiments were only read by powerhouse-runtime daily() and never closed, leaving 210 PLANNED and 8 ACTIVE (no meetpunt, CONTINUE_MEASURING forever) so the learning loop stayed open at outcome.
prevention: A daily cron closes stale rci rows (PLANNED >1 day past date, ACTIVE without meetpunt after 14 days) as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; a staleness view must read 0; AGENTS.md and a skill require a closing rule for every new experiment type.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until the migration is applied and the staleness view reads 0

limitations: Closed rows count as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not as learnings
